Cook time: 15 minutes Total time: 15 minutes Number of Servings: 4 Ingredients 1 cup bulgur 2 cups water Directions Wash hands with soap and water. In a saucepan, combine bulgur and water; bring to a boil. Cover the pan, reduce heat to simmer and cook until tender, about 12 minutes. Drain off excess liquid, fluff with a fork and serve as desired. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
